title: OAS rejects fraud threats and urges Peru to finalize presidential vote count
detail: The Organization of American States (OAS) electoral observation mission issued a public statement explicitly rejecting threats made against Peruvian electoral authorities and calling on Peru to complete its delayed first-round presidential count. The OAS endorsed the JNE's direction toward the June 7 runoff and reaffirmed the integrity of electoral processes despite the ballot-delivery failures that had delayed certification. The statement came as Peru remained in an unusual post-electoral limbo: no official result declared nearly a month after voting, with López Aliaga's incitement charges adding to institutional instability.

media.caption: OAS electoral observation mission calls on Peru to complete presidential vote count and reject intimidation
